baseline.name: pyzmq P2P head-of-line blocking, silent loss, duplicate execution (F1/F2)
notes: ACK timeout = MessagerTransportConfig.request_timeout=1.0s on the sender (real config field, default 10.0s); slow handler sleeps 2.0s; 50 fast msgs sent concurrently 50ms after the slow one from one sender instance (node_id='sender').

A = sender with node_id='sender' (every DEALER shares that routing id); A2 = sender with node_id=None (real code then picks a random routing id per send) -> pure HOL. Latency percentiles exclude timed-out sends (see *_ack_timeouts).
Retry simulation: send() called twice with identical EventMessage (same payload.message_id); no transport-level retry exists in the API.
Log capture: pyzmq_backend.team_logger wrapped by a forwarding recorder (identical in both modes).
Phase D: receiver ROUTER.recv_multipart patched to raise for 300ms; spins = loop iterations in that window.
